What is Apple Watch Schooltime and where do buyers see it?

Schooltime is a watchOS managed-device and education feature for supervised student Apple Watches during school hours. When Schooltime is on, the watch shows a Schooltime lock screen, follows a schedule, restricts apps and notifications, and typically requires a passcode or parent approval to exit. Buyers encounter it on family-managed or education-managed watches — not as general Screen Time Downtime on iPhone.
